title: Vintage Newspaper Front Page Design
summary: Hyper-realistic vintage newspaper front page wrapping a subject photo in cinematic black-and-white — aged paper texture, ink defects, fictitious masthead, and editorial column layout.
prompt: Create the most realistic front page design of a vintage newspaper featuring the main character. The layout should be made in the style of a real printed newspaper with cinematic black-and-white aesthetic. Main photo prominently placed in the center, framed as the title image. Subject remains unchanged and clearly distinguishable in natural light with increased contrast for editorial style. Include: bold attention-grabbing headline at the top with unique title matching the photo's spirit; smaller subtitle as real newspaper caption; realistic newspaper elements: columns of small text in lorem ipsum style framed like real news; fictitious publication name at top; date, issue number and location; decorative lines, dividers, and vintage typography; small additional articles or captions; optional stamps, doodles, or editorial notes. Style: Black and white or slightly faded monochrome paper; fine paper texture, grain, and ink defects; small shadows and creases mimicking real printed paper; aesthetics of clean but slightly worn vintage newspaper. Mood: Give the design personality, expressiveness and plot. Aspect ratio: 4:5 or 1:1. High-detail, ultra-realistic hybrid of editorial photography and print design.
